subject: Geopolitics
title: Climate Alliances
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Climate Alliances.

hook.text: The Paris Agreement united 196 nations on climate. But pledges are voluntary and most nations miss their targets.

buildup.text: Climate alliances try to coordinate emission cuts across rivals. The atmosphere doesn't care about borders.

discovery.text: Climate cooperation has a free-rider problem. Each nation wants others to cut while preserving its own growth.

twist.text: Climate clubs with trade penalties might work better. If dirty producers face tariffs, incentives align.

climax.text: The EU's carbon border tax is the first real enforcement. Others will follow, creating a climate trade bloc.

punchline.text: Saving the planet requires alliances unlike any before.

quiz.question: What is the main weakness of the Paris Agreement?
options: Pledges are voluntary and most nations miss targets
